command:
set -euo pipefail
echo '=== AVATAR WINDOW IDENTITY MAP READONLY ==='
date -Is
for w in $(DISPLAY=:0 xdotool search --onlyvisible --name 'FranKenstein' 2>/dev/null || true); do
  echo WINDOW=$w
  DISPLAY=:0 xdotool getwindowname $w 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/NAME=/' || true
  DISPLAY=:0 xdotool getwindowpid $w 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/PID=/' || true
  DISPLAY=:0 xdotool getwindowgeometry --shell $w 2>/dev/null || true
  xprop -id $w WM_CLASS _NET_WM_PID 2>/dev/null || true
  p=$(DISPLAY=:0 xdotool getwindowpid $w 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -n "${p:-}" ] && [ -r /proc/$p/cmdline ]; then printf 'CMD='; tr '\0' ' ' </proc/$p/cmdline; echo; fi
  echo '---'
done
echo '=== CHROME TOPLEVELS ==='
for w in $(DISPLAY=:0 xdotool search --onlyvisible --class 'google-chrome' 2>/dev/null || true); do p=$(DISPLAY=:0 xdotool getwindowpid $w 2>/dev/null || true); n=$(DISPLAY=:0 xdotool getwindowname $w 2>/dev/null || true); g=$(DISPLAY=:0 xdotool getwindowgeometry --shell $w 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' ' || true); echo "W=$w PID=$p NAME=$n $g"; done
echo '=== END MAP ==='
